title: Why don't transcription factors exploit inter-nucleotide correlations in binding motifs? Evolution of information encoding strategies on DNA
authors: Emmanuel Mekasha; Elia Mascolo; Ivan Erill
one_liner_zh: 该文通过进化模拟和理论分析探讨TF-DNA结合基序为何偏好独立位点信息而非相关性编码，虽涉及TF-DNA结合机制，但缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，属于理论进化生物学研究，对课题有背景启发但方法不匹配。
abstract: Transcription factors have been shown to predominantly rely on independent contributions from each position of their target sequence motifs, even though sequence motifs can encode information through correlations among nucleotide positions. As a result, the position-weight matrix, a simple modeling approach that assumes independence among positions, has long since become the dominant model of TF-DNA binding. Why evolution would favor this comparatively simple strategy, known as single locus information (SI), over a correlation-based one remains unaddressed. Here, we use analytical derivations, numerical approaches and evolutionary simulations to show that SI is intrinsically more robust to mutation than correlated (multi-locus) encodings and is therefore indirectly favored under selection for functional transcriptional regulatory networks. At the same time, we show that SI smooths the affinity landscape, ensuring the evolvability of regulatory interactions. We find the same marked bias toward SI in the genetic code, suggesting that the preference for SI is not specific to transcriptional regulation, but may be a general property of biological codes that must reliably store information on DNA in the face of mutational noise.
abstract_zh: 转录因子已被证明主要依赖于其靶序列基序中每个位置的独立贡献，尽管序列基序可以通过核苷酸位置间的相关性来编码信息。因此，位置权重矩阵——一种假设位置间独立性的简单建模方法——早已成为转录因子-DNA结合的主导模型。为何进化会偏好这种相对简单的策略，即单基因座信息（single locus information, SI），而非基于相关性的策略，这一问题仍未得到解答。在此，我们通过解析推导、数值方法和进化模拟表明，SI在本质上比相关（多基因座）编码对突变更具稳健性，因此在功能性转录调控网络的选择下间接受到青睐。同时，我们证明SI平滑了亲和力景观，确保了调控相互作用的可进化性。我们在遗传密码中也发现了同样显著的SI偏好，这表明对SI的偏好并非转录调控所特有，而可能是生物密码在面临突变噪声时须可靠存储于DNA上的一种普遍属性。
